meta.title: Ever Onward
meta.description: Bathe in the shining lights and take a new step forward.

units.rawText: Outer Oasis Plaza.
units.displayText: Outer Oasis Plaza.

spans.text: Outer Oasis Plaza.

units.rawText: The motorcycle bolts past, its red-haired driver stopping it with a spin, rushing towards the prearranged meeting place.
units.displayText: The motorcycle bolts past, its red-haired driver stopping it with a spin, rushing towards the prearranged meeting place.

spans.text: The motorcycle bolts past, its red-haired driver stopping it with a spin, rushing towards the prearranged meeting place.

units.rawText: Phew, barely made it...
units.displayText: Phew, barely made it...

spans.text: Phew, barely made it...

units.rawText: What do you mean made it? You're half an hour late, Bonneville! Any later, and I would've finished this book I have on hand!
units.displayText: What do you mean made it? You're half an hour late, Bonneville! Any later, and I would've finished this book I have on hand!

spans.text: What do you mean made it? You're half an hour late, Bonneville! Any later, and I would've finished this book I have on hand!

units.rawText: Sorry, sorry, my bad. Didn't keep a good handle on how much time I spent driving with the Professor.
units.displayText: Sorry, sorry, my bad. Didn't keep a good handle on how much time I spent driving with the Professor.

spans.text: Sorry, sorry, my bad. Didn't keep a good handle on how much time I spent driving with the Professor.

units.rawText: Bonneville produces a thin brown paper bag, handing it to Shale.
units.displayText: Bonneville produces a thin brown paper bag, handing it to Shale.

spans.text: Bonneville produces a thin brown paper bag, handing it to Shale.

units.rawText: Here, this is yours. Think of it as compensation.
units.displayText: Here, this is yours. Think of it as compensation.

spans.text: Here, this is yours. Think of it as compensation.

units.rawText: What's the need to be so mysterious...
units.displayText: What's the need to be so mysterious...

spans.text: What's the need to be so mysterious...

units.rawText: Woah! T-this is Nora's new periodical? Signed, too?!
units.displayText: Woah! T-this is Nora's new periodical? Signed, too?!

spans.text: Woah! T-this is Nora's new periodical? Signed, too?!

units.rawText: Yeah, ran into a signing when I went to buy it. Got pretty lucky.
units.displayText: Yeah, ran into a signing when I went to buy it. Got pretty lucky.

spans.text: Yeah, ran into a signing when I went to buy it. Got pretty lucky.

units.rawText: ...Look at yourself, Mistress. Stare at it any longer, and your drool might just reach the floor, hm?
units.displayText: ...Look at yourself, Mistress. Stare at it any longer, and your drool might just reach the floor, hm?

spans.text: ...Look at yourself, Mistress. Stare at it any longer, and your drool might just reach the floor, hm?

units.rawText: Huh? Ah!
units.displayText: Huh? Ah!

spans.text: Huh? Ah!

units.rawText: Shale immediately wipes at the corners of her mouth upon receiving that reminder, coughing as she refocuses on work.
units.displayText: Shale immediately wipes at the corners of her mouth upon receiving that reminder, coughing as she refocuses on work.

spans.text: Shale immediately wipes at the corners of her mouth upon receiving that reminder, coughing as she refocuses on work.

units.rawText: Cough! Considering the circumstances, I shall forgive you this time. Don't count on it happening again!
units.displayText: Cough! Considering the circumstances, I shall forgive you this time. Don't count on it happening again!

spans.text: Cough! Considering the circumstances, I shall forgive you this time. Don't count on it happening again!

units.rawText: Yeah, yeah, got it~
units.displayText: Yeah, yeah, got it~

spans.text: Yeah, yeah, got it~

units.rawText: Right, hit up the Boss when you have time.
units.displayText: Right, hit up the Boss when you have time.

spans.text: Right, hit up the Boss when you have time.

units.rawText: The Boss wants to talk to me? Crap, it can't be her chewing me out for getting you to write my reports for me, right?
units.displayText: The Boss wants to talk to me? Crap, it can't be her chewing me out for getting you to write my reports for me, right?

spans.text: The Boss wants to talk to me? Crap, it can't be her chewing me out for getting you to write my reports for me, right?

units.rawText: Oh, I can't comment on that... good luck, in any case~
units.displayText: Oh, I can't comment on that... good luck, in any case~

spans.text: Oh, I can't comment on that... good luck, in any case~

units.rawText: Bonneville feels an ill omen. She begins to inquire further, but Shale is also engrossed with the pamphlet in her hands.
units.displayText: Bonneville feels an ill omen. She begins to inquire further, but Shale is also engrossed with the pamphlet in her hands.

spans.text: Bonneville feels an ill omen. She begins to inquire further, but Shale is also engrossed with the pamphlet in her hands.

units.rawText: Bonneville sighs, turning around and punching a number into her terminal.
units.displayText: Bonneville sighs, turning around and punching a number into her terminal.

spans.text: Bonneville sighs, turning around and punching a number into her terminal.

units.rawText: Yo, long time no see, Boss.
units.displayText: Yo, long time no see, Boss.

spans.text: Yo, long time no see, Boss.

units.rawText: Oh, Bonneville. How has the Oasis treated you recently?
units.displayText: Oh, Bonneville. How has the Oasis treated you recently?

spans.text: Oh, Bonneville. How has the Oasis treated you recently?

units.rawText: Not quite what I expected, both the people and the roads here are to my taste... pretty good, all things considered.
units.displayText: Not quite what I expected, both the people and the roads here are to my taste... pretty good, all things considered.

spans.text: Not quite what I expected, both the people and the roads here are to my taste... pretty good, all things considered.

units.rawText: Mission progress has been largely smooth too. Me and Shale will be going back to Arcadia in a few days, I'll bring you a few souvenirs.
units.displayText: Mission progress has been largely smooth too. Me and Shale will be going back to Arcadia in a few days, I'll bring you a few souvenirs.

spans.text: Mission progress has been largely smooth too. Me and Shale will be going back to Arcadia in a few days, I'll bring you a few souvenirs.

units.rawText: Hehe, no need to rush. If you are so inclined, staying a while more at the Oasis is fine, too.
units.displayText: Hehe, no need to rush. If you are so inclined, staying a while more at the Oasis is fine, too.

spans.text: Hehe, no need to rush. If you are so inclined, staying a while more at the Oasis is fine, too.

units.rawText: Are you going to ask me about the Professor, Boss? I thought you wanted to talk to me because you wanted a report.
units.displayText: Are you going to ask me about the Professor, Boss? I thought you wanted to talk to me because you wanted a report.

spans.text: Are you going to ask me about the Professor, Boss? I thought you wanted to talk to me because you wanted a report.

units.rawText: Hahaha, those things are obvious from your expressions alone.
units.displayText: Hahaha, those things are obvious from your expressions alone.

spans.text: Hahaha, those things are obvious from your expressions alone.

units.rawText: Perhaps you haven't noticed yourself, but from where I'm looking, your expression's a lot softer than what you wore when you set off.
units.displayText: Perhaps you haven't noticed yourself, but from where I'm looking, your expression's a lot softer than what you wore when you set off.

spans.text: Perhaps you haven't noticed yourself, but from where I'm looking, your expression's a lot softer than what you wore when you set off.

units.rawText: And the reports you submitted... ghostwritten by Shale, are they not?
units.displayText: And the reports you submitted... ghostwritten by Shale, are they not?

spans.text: And the reports you submitted... ghostwritten by Shale, are they not?

units.rawText: The redhead sighs in an exaggerated manner.
units.displayText: The redhead sighs in an exaggerated manner.

spans.text: The redhead sighs in an exaggerated manner.

units.rawText: Man, nothing gets past you, Boss...
units.displayText: Man, nothing gets past you, Boss...

spans.text: Man, nothing gets past you, Boss...

units.rawText: Reports and whatever are still a pain for me, you see... If you asked me to write one, I'd have no idea what to put in there.
units.displayText: Reports and whatever are still a pain for me, you see... If you asked me to write one, I'd have no idea what to put in there.

spans.text: Reports and whatever are still a pain for me, you see... If you asked me to write one, I'd have no idea what to put in there.

units.rawText: Just speak what's on your mind, Bonneville. There's no need to think so much about it.
units.displayText: Just speak what's on your mind, Bonneville. There's no need to think so much about it.

spans.text: Just speak what's on your mind, Bonneville. There's no need to think so much about it.

units.rawText: Hm, how to put it... I don't really know how to express this, but the Professor's for sure more interesting than I imagined.
units.displayText: Hm, how to put it... I don't really know how to express this, but the Professor's for sure more interesting than I imagined.

spans.text: Hm, how to put it... I don't really know how to express this, but the Professor's for sure more interesting than I imagined.

units.rawText: They work late into the night to prepare return presents; they study beforehand to compete with me... if it's anything related to a Doll, they'll give it every bit of effort.
units.displayText: They work late into the night to prepare return presents; they study beforehand to compete with me... if it's anything related to a Doll, they'll give it every bit of effort.

spans.text: They work late into the night to prepare return presents; they study beforehand to compete with me... if it's anything related to a Doll, they'll give it every bit of effort.

units.rawText: I think I get why everyone at the Oasis adores them as much as they do.
units.displayText: I think I get why everyone at the Oasis adores them as much as they do.

spans.text: I think I get why everyone at the Oasis adores them as much as they do.

units.rawText: You'd give them a high rating, then.
units.displayText: You'd give them a high rating, then.

spans.text: You'd give them a high rating, then.

units.rawText: Mhmm, should've figured those rumors on the outside aren't worth squat~
units.displayText: Mhmm, should've figured those rumors on the outside aren't worth squat~

spans.text: Mhmm, should've figured those rumors on the outside aren't worth squat~

units.rawText: But a reversal of attitude from me was within your realm of expectation too, right Boss?
units.displayText: But a reversal of attitude from me was within your realm of expectation too, right Boss?

spans.text: But a reversal of attitude from me was within your realm of expectation too, right Boss?

units.rawText: The person on the other end of the call responds with silence.
units.displayText: The person on the other end of the call responds with silence.

spans.text: The person on the other end of the call responds with silence.

units.rawText: I don't really know what you meant to do, but making someone no good at diplomacy like me to be a go-between with the Oasis was weird no matter how I looked at it.
units.displayText: I don't really know what you meant to do, but making someone no good at diplomacy like me to be a go-between with the Oasis was weird no matter how I looked at it.

spans.text: I don't really know what you meant to do, but making someone no good at diplomacy like me to be a go-between with the Oasis was weird no matter how I looked at it.

units.rawText: Can't think of anything other than that you had some other plan in mind.
units.displayText: Can't think of anything other than that you had some other plan in mind.

spans.text: Can't think of anything other than that you had some other plan in mind.

units.rawText: Bonneville, you've always had a bad habit of making things complicated with how you process things.
units.displayText: Bonneville, you've always had a bad habit of making things complicated with how you process things.

spans.text: Bonneville, you've always had a bad habit of making things complicated with how you process things.

units.rawText: Maybe I saw the potential for being a negotiator in you, and sent you on an assignment where you could improve those skills?
units.displayText: Maybe I saw the potential for being a negotiator in you, and sent you on an assignment where you could improve those skills?

spans.text: Maybe I saw the potential for being a negotiator in you, and sent you on an assignment where you could improve those skills?

units.rawText: Seriously? No, no, no, stop playing with me like that!
units.displayText: Seriously? No, no, no, stop playing with me like that!

spans.text: Seriously? No, no, no, stop playing with me like that!

units.rawText: Boss, you got the answers you were looking for?
units.displayText: Boss, you got the answers you were looking for?

spans.text: Boss, you got the answers you were looking for?

units.rawText: Yes. I think I might have to meet with the Professor soon enough.
units.displayText: Yes. I think I might have to meet with the Professor soon enough.

spans.text: Yes. I think I might have to meet with the Professor soon enough.

units.rawText: ...Didn't see that one coming. I thought you would've sat and observed for a little more like the original plan.
units.displayText: ...Didn't see that one coming. I thought you would've sat and observed for a little more like the original plan.

spans.text: ...Didn't see that one coming. I thought you would've sat and observed for a little more like the original plan.

units.rawText: Changes must be made, Bonneville. This world has no more excess that I and the Professor can squander in prodding away at each other.
units.displayText: Changes must be made, Bonneville. This world has no more excess that I and the Professor can squander in prodding away at each other.

spans.text: Changes must be made, Bonneville. This world has no more excess that I and the Professor can squander in prodding away at each other.

units.rawText: I understand. For Arcadia.
units.displayText: I understand. For Arcadia.

spans.text: I understand. For Arcadia.

units.rawText: Yes. For Arcadia.
units.displayText: Yes. For Arcadia.

spans.text: Yes. For Arcadia.
